Run it on your laptop

This week's code runs in VS Code or PyCharm, not in the page. Keep one project folder with a virtual environment:

python -m venv .venv
.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1
pip install pytest selenium

Use the Copy button on any code block. Answers that end in assert lines check themselves: no error means correct.

Stuck? Paste your code and the error to Claude.

Practice database

A small pharmacy and retail shop. It has some data defects on purpose, for you to find.

How to use a lesson

Every grey box is a live editor. Change the query, press Run (or Ctrl+Enter), and see the result. Try each exercise yourself before you open the answer.
